title: FoundCause: A Foundation Model for Causal Discovery with Latent Confounders from Observational Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.17516v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data requires recovering directed relations and latent confounding without interventions. We propose FoundCause, an {\em amortized causal discovery foundation model} trained only on synthetic structural causal models that maps datasets to causal graphs in a single forward pass. A permutation-equivariant transformer alternates attention over samples and variables to model cross-variable dependence and per-variable distributions. Pairwise dependence and asymmetry statistics guide its attention, edge decoder and confounder module. The decoder separates edge existence from direction, while triangular refinement incorporates evidence from chains and colliders. Learnable latent tokens predict which variable pairs share a hidden common cause, and a masked input representation handles missing data. To our knowledge, FoundCause is the first amortized causal discovery approach for i.i.d. observational

translated_title: FoundCause：一个从观测数据中发现含潜在混杂因素因果关系的基础模型
translated_abstract: 从观测数据中进行因果发现需要在不进行干预的情况下恢复有向关系和潜在混杂因素。我们提出了FoundCause，这是一个摊销式（amortized）因果发现基础模型，仅在合成结构因果模型上训练，能够在单次前向传播中将数据集映射为因果图。一个置换等变的Transformer交替关注样本和变量，以建模变量间的依赖关系和各变量的分布。成对依赖性和不对称性统计信息引导其注意力机制、边解码器和混杂因素模块。解码器将边的存在性与方向分离，而三角细化则融合来自链结构和碰撞结构的证据。可学习的潜在token预测哪些变量对共享隐藏的共同原因，掩码输入表示则用于处理缺失数据。据我们所知，FoundCause是首个针对独立同分布观测数据的摊销式因果发现方法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: FoundCause是首个仅在合成结构因果模型上训练的摊销式因果发现基础模型，能够通过单次前向传播从独立同分布观测数据中恢复因果图、识别潜在混杂因素并处理缺失数据。
en_tdlr: FoundCause is the first amortized causal discovery foundation model trained only on synthetic structural causal models, which recovers causal graphs, detects latent confounders, and handles missing data from i.i.d. observational datasets in a single forward pass.
